topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic establishes the framing, difficulty, and educational context for the lecture on complement.

topics.label: Fundamentals and central role of C3 in complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the core organizational principles, nomenclature conventions, and the pivotal biochemical role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the distinct upstream recognition pathways that generate convertases to reach the complement activation threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the downstream effector mechanisms by which activated complement clears pathogens and drives inflammation.

topics.label: Regulation of complement and host protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the regulatory mechanisms and host-surface proteins that prevent accidental complement activation on self cells.

topics.label: Clinical manifestations of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct disease phenotypes and pathological consequences resulting from deficiencies in specific complement proteins.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion strategies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the molecular mechanisms evolved by pathogens to resist and circumvent complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and next steps
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic delivers the closing remarks and previews the topic of the next lecture.
